reviews.title: Paid in Advance, They Changed the Rules
reviews.text:
What happened to this app?

I paid for Cosmo in advance, and after taking my money, the company changed the service to a credit-based system. Now I’m being told I can’t fully use features I already paid for because I supposedly don’t have enough credits.

That is not a minor update. That is a fundamental change to what customers purchased.

If the credit system had been disclosed before I paid, fine. I could have decided whether it was worth it. But changing the rules after customers have already prepaid is a completely different issue, and I seriously question whether that is acceptable from a consumer-protection standpoint.

The frustrating part is that Cosmo used to be one of the best apps in this space. The old version was far better. Now it feels more restrictive, more expensive, and objectively worse for longtime paying customers.

If you already collected payment under the old model, those customers should be grandfathered into what they paid for. Period.

reviews.title: Subscription Changed After Renewal
reviews.text: Buyer beware if you’re considering the annual subscription. I’ve been a paying subscriber for well over a year and renewed my annual subscription in June 2026 because I regularly used the Face Retouch and Makeup editing features that were included. After renewing, the app was completely redesigned and many of those features now require the purchase of additional credits. The subscription I renewed is not the same experience I had been paying for. I contacted customer support multiple times and received only automated responses with no resolution. I cannot recommend paying for an annual subscription based on my experience.

reviews.title: Horrible update
reviews.text:
This app used to be my go-to for the most subtle natural photo enhancement. The COOL AI filter was the most believable, most natural, one touch easy setting.  Please bring it back!  It filter, you into a more flattering light, brightening the complexion without changing your face. 

The old format was so much easier to use. I had already paid my dues for the year, yet somehow, the app is asking me to purchase credits.  Not cool. Without the simplified cool setting what’s left is an unrealistic choice of heavy, fake face filters.  Bring nack COOL and the old format please!

reviews.title: Total Bait-and-Switch Scam – Paid Features Stripped
reviews.text: Do not download this app and do not trust this developer (Spark Dynamics). I purchased a full annual subscription that was valid through November. Without warning, they pushed an update that completely wiped out every single feature, tool, and piece of content that I legally paid for. Now, the app is completely locked and demanding that I pay for a brand-new subscription tier just to use it. This is fraudulent behavior and a total breach of trust. I had to contact Apple Support directly to force a manual refund. Avoid this developer at all costs.
